summary: Styles for input fields, body, and login page components.
evidence: .inputField styles for input fields with light transparent background, blue border, and glow effect on focus.
.black styles for the login page background with a centered box-shadow and white background.
.loginPageChild styles for the login page child component with a centered box-shadow and blue background.
.student styles for the student image with a border-radius and position.
.unionIcon styles for the union icon with a position and size.
.unionIcon1 styles for the union icon in the right side with a position and size.
.unionIcon2 styles for the union icon at the bottom with a position and size.
.loginBox styles for the login box with a position, box-shadow, and white background.
